result.explanation: Track one active transfer. Verified chunks are applied only when structurally valid and non-conflicting; invalid, conflicting, and irrelevant events preserve the prior transfer state as required.
result.mapping: The opaque state stores active id, declared length, and an array whose null entries are unknown bytes. Output derives id, distinct received count, status, and complete data from those variables.
result.assumptions: Malformed or unknown events produce status invalid while preserving state. Event ids are compared by JavaScript JSON value equality; legal task inputs otherwise follow the stated scalar constraints.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const o of output){if(!o||typeof o!=="object"||Object.keys(o).length!==4||!("status"in o)||!("id"in o)||!("received"in o)||!("data"in o))return false;if(o.data==="__changed")return false}return true}
